description: This file defines data models and validation logic for managing boards and blocks within the focalboard project, including structures for creating, validating, deleting, and patching boards and blocks.

classes.name: BlockDoesntBelongToAnyBoardErr
classes.description: Custom error type indicating a block does not belong to any board.

classes.name: BoardsAndBlocks
classes.description: Data model representing a collection of boards and blocks with validation logic.

classes.name: DeleteBoardsAndBlocks
classes.description: Data model for specifying boards and blocks to delete.

classes.name: PatchBoardsAndBlocks
classes.description: Data model for patching multiple boards and blocks.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the BoardsAndBlocks, DeleteBoardsAndBlocks, and PatchBoardsAndBlocks structures.

methods.name: NewDeleteBoardsAndBlocksFromBabs
methods.description: Creates a DeleteBoardsAndBlocks instance from a BoardsAndBlocks object.

methods.name: GenerateBoardsAndBlocksIDs
methods.description: Generates new IDs for boards and blocks, returning a new BoardsAndBlocks object.

methods.name: BoardsAndBlocksFromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into a BoardsAndBlocks object.
